title: 😈Icky, Mean, Hateful: On the nature of evil in psychotherapy

sentences.en: That boy needs therapy, psychosomatic, that boy needs therapy, psychosomatic, that boy needs therapy, lie down on the couch, that boy needs therapy.
sentences.zh: 那孩子需要治疗，身心失调，那孩子需要治疗，身心失调，那孩子需要治疗，躺在沙发上，那孩子需要治疗。

sentences.en: Hey guys, it's Joel with the Taproot Therapy Collective podcast and today I'm going to be reading an article called Icky, Mean, and Hateful on the nature of evil in psychotherapy.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是 Joel，来自 Taproot Therapy Collective 播客。今天我要读一篇文章，题目是《讨厌、刻薄与仇恨》，探讨心理治疗中“恶”的本质。

sentences.en: It's a longer article if it's easier for you to read something like this.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得阅读这类文章比较轻松，这篇会稍微长一点。

sentences.en: I recommend you check out our website at www.gettherapybirmingham.com, navigate to the tab where it says blog, and read it where you can find this and other articles that
sentences.zh: 我建议大家访问我们的网站 www.gettherapybirmingham.com，导航到“博客”标签页，在那里你可以找到这篇文章以及其他一些

sentences.en: are not available on the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 播客中没有的内容。

sentences.en: I don't record every article.
sentences.zh: 我并没有把每一篇文章都录制成音频。

sentences.en: And so the article begins.
sentences.zh: 那么，文章开始了。

sentences.en: One of the things that happens frequently in family therapy is that a person or a group of family members will accuse the other person or group of family members of being mean or
sentences.zh: 家庭治疗中经常发生的一件事是，一个人或一组家庭成员会指责另一个人或另一组家庭成员刻薄或

sentences.en: hateful.
sentences.zh: 充满仇恨。

sentences.en: Now most of the time if someone is abusive or they are intentionally hurtful, they won't deny that they have ill intentions.
sentences.zh: 大多数时候，如果一个人确实有虐待行为或蓄意伤人，他们是不会否认自己怀有恶意的。

sentences.en: They think the other person deserves it and they'll make that clear in therapy.
sentences.zh: 他们认为对方罪有应得，并且会在治疗中明确表达这一点。

sentences.en: So put simply, someone who has meant to be mean will usually admit that when they're accused of it.
sentences.zh: 简单来说，一个存心刻薄的人，在被指责时通常会承认这一点。

sentences.en: Other times, one side denies intentionally trying to hurt the person, accusing them of trying to cause harm, and they say they didn't mean to hurt them.
sentences.zh: 但在其他时候，一方会否认自己蓄意伤害对方，反过来指责对方试图造成伤害，并声称他们并非有意伤人。

sentences.en: So when this happens, I draw a line down a piece of paper, and I have each side write down what they remember was said, you know, the hateful thing.
sentences.zh: 所以当这种情况发生时，我会在纸上画一条线，让双方写下他们记忆中对方所说的话，也就是那些“充满仇恨”的话。

sentences.en: So on one side of the paper, there will be an objective statement.
sentences.zh: 纸的一侧会写下客观陈述。

sentences.en: And these statements might include something like, you drank too much and you yelled at me, or you spent more money than you said you would, or you didn't do what you told
sentences.zh: 这些陈述可能包括：“你喝多了，对我大吼大叫”，或者“你花的钱比你承诺的要多”，或者“你没有做你答应

sentences.en: me you would.
sentences.zh: 要做的事”。

sentences.en: And then on the other side, there will be a subjective statement, which is what the other person remembers, who's calling the first person mean or hateful.
sentences.zh: 而在另一侧，则是主观陈述，也就是指责对方刻薄或充满仇恨的那个人所记忆的内容。

sentences.en: And it will have something that is subjective, usually something like this.
sentences.zh: 这上面会有一些主观的东西，通常是这样的：

sentences.en: You said I'm obnoxious, or you said I'm stupid and I can't do math.
sentences.zh: “你说我很讨厌”，或者“你说我很笨，连数学都不会”。

sentences.en: So these statements refer to the same event, but each party hears two different things.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些陈述指的是同一件事，但双方听到的却是两码事。

sentences.en: So when we don't want to grow or change, when other people offer us criticism, you know, constructive or not, or they just ask us nicely to change, we view them asking us to change
sentences.zh: 当我们不想成长或改变时，当别人向我们提出批评——无论是建设性的还是其他——或者只是委婉地要求我们改变时，我们会把他们要求我们改变

sentences.en: our behavior as an attack, because we don't believe that they can't.
sentences.zh: 行为的请求视为一种攻击，因为我们不相信他们真的不能（接受现状）。

sentences.en: We view it as a judgment, which is why that second column is full of subjective statements.
sentences.zh: 我们将其视为一种评判，这就是为什么第二栏里全是主观陈述的原因。

sentences.en: So when someone points out that I went over budget, it's easier for me to feel like they are in the wrong for making me feel stupid, than accepting that I could change the behavior
sentences.zh: 所以，当有人指出我超支了，比起接受我本可以改变行为

sentences.en: or learn new things.
sentences.zh: 或学习新事物，我更容易觉得是他们不对，因为他们让我觉得自己很蠢。

sentences.en: And when I get drunk, it's easier for me to think that someone is judging me than it is to admit that I made a mistake and maybe feel some guilt or shame.
sentences.zh: 当我喝醉时，比起承认自己犯了错并感到内疚或羞愧，我更容易认为别人是在评判我。

sentences.en: So, you know, I tell clients often in psychotherapy that avoiding conflict does not make them a good person.
sentences.zh: 所以，我在心理治疗中经常告诉来访者，逃避冲突并不能让你成为一个好人。

sentences.en: If you're avoidant at all and you've come to therapy with me, you've heard that.
sentences.zh: 如果你有逃避倾向，并且来找我做过治疗，你一定听过这句话。

sentences.en: So often what avoidance does, or avoiding conflict or difficult conversations, or even avoiding being assertive, and the worst is avoiding what we know is true in our own head.
sentences.zh: 逃避——无论是逃避冲突、逃避困难的对话，甚至是逃避果断行事，最糟糕的是逃避我们内心深知的事实——往往会带来什么后果呢？

sentences.en: We can't even think it.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至不敢去想它。

sentences.en: Your therapist is just asking you to think it, and you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 你的治疗师只是让你去思考它，而你却做不到。

sentences.en: That makes us enablers of bad behavior, and it makes us contributors to the problematic state of this world.
sentences.zh: 这使我们成为了不良行为的助长者，也让我们成为了这个世界问题状态的推手。

sentences.en: It makes us contribute to evil when we are avoidant.
sentences.zh: 当我们选择逃避时，我们就在助长邪恶。

sentences.en: And one of the ways that we do this is by pretending that the truth is always in the middle of each conflict, and that all perspectives are equally valid.
sentences.zh: 我们这样做的方式之一，就是假装真相总是存在于冲突的中间地带，并且所有观点都同样有效。

sentences.en: This is avoidance, because holding the authority to judge one side versus another makes you feel icky or judgy.
sentences.zh: 这是一种逃避，因为掌握评判是非的权力会让你感到不舒服或觉得自己像个评判者。

sentences.en: You know, you are around people who are judgmental.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你身边都是些爱评判别人的人。

sentences.en: You don't want to be like that.
sentences.zh: 你不想成为那样的人。

sentences.en: Well, you're not.
sentences.zh: 好吧，你并不是。

sentences.en: If you're being assertive, you're just being honeSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你在果断行事，你只是在诚实面对。

sentences.en: We want life to be this children's movie where all conflict is just a misunderstanding between two benevolent parties, and both sides have a good point.
sentences.zh: 我们希望生活像儿童电影那样，所有的冲突都只是两个善意方之间的误解，双方都有道理。

sentences.en: And sometimes that's true, but that is not always true, and trying to turn all conflict into that just isn't life.
sentences.zh: 有时确实如此，但并非总是如此。试图把所有冲突都简化成那样，那不是生活。

sentences.en: It's not adult.
sentences.zh: 那不是成年人的做法。

sentences.en: Sometimes people do say and believe things that are just wrong.
sentences.zh: 有时人们确实会说出并相信一些完全错误的事情。

sentences.en: Each person could have a valuable perspective, and they could make a unique contribution to our collective reality, but the operative word here is could.
sentences.zh: 每个人都可以有宝贵的视角，也可以对我们的集体现实做出独特的贡献，但这里的关键词是“可以”。

sentences.en: Not everyone chooses to.
sentences.zh: 并非每个人都会选择这样做。

sentences.en: And if you're pretending that everyone will or everyone was, I don't know that that's honest or going to help you get anywhere in family or individual therapy.
sentences.zh: 如果你假装每个人都会这样做，或者每个人都曾这样做，我不确定这是否诚实，也不确定这是否有助于你在家庭或个人治疗中取得进展。

sentences.en: Any person's validity of perspective is predicated on that person's ability to be honest with themselves.
sentences.zh: 任何人的视角是否有效，取决于此人能否对自己诚实。

sentences.en: How can I be honest with anyone if I can't even look in the mirror and be honest with myself?
sentences.zh: 如果我连照镜子对自己诚实都做不到，我又怎么能对别人诚实呢？

sentences.en: If you can't be honest with yourself or accept objective reality, you know, things that are just true about something, then every word that you say about that thing or that topic
sentences.zh: 如果你不能对自己诚实，或者不能接受客观现实——也就是关于某事物的既定事实——那么你所说的关于那个事物或话题的每一句话，

sentences.en: that you can't be honest with yourself about is a lie, whether or not you mean it to me.
sentences.zh: 只要是你无法对自己诚实的部分，那都是谎言，无论你是否有意为之。

sentences.en: It may be an unconscious lie.
sentences.zh: 这可能是一个无意识的谎言。

sentences.en: A lot of people say, well, the person doesn't know that it wasn't true.
sentences.zh: 很多人会说：“好吧，那个人并不知道那不是真的。”

sentences.en: And it's like, well, they were there.
sentences.zh: 而我的回应是：“好吧，他们当时也在场。”

sentences.en: You both saw the same thing.
sentences.zh: 你们俩看到的是同一件事。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Yeah, but they just don't know it.
sentences.zh: “是啊，但他们就是不知道。”

sentences.en: And I understand what they mean.
sentences.zh: 我明白他们的意思。

sentences.en: They mean that that person is just kind of unconsciously panicking and refusing themselves,
sentences.zh: 他们的意思是，那个人只是在无意识地恐慌，在拒绝自己，

sentences.en: refusing to let themselves know something that is true because it makes them feel icky or judgy or whatever.
sentences.zh: 拒绝让自己知道某些真实存在的事实，因为这会让他们感到不舒服、觉得自己像个评判者之类的。

sentences.en: It doesn't matter if you mean to be lying or not.
sentences.zh: 你是否有意撒谎并不重要。

sentences.en: But if you pretend that unconscious or unintentional dishonesty is just a perspective somebody
sentences.zh: 但如果你假装这种无意识或非故意的虚假仅仅是某人的一个“视角”，

sentences.en: has, and that deserves our consideration, you know, and everyone needs to consider this and treat, you know, something that's true and something that's false as equally valid
sentences.zh: 并且认为这值得我们考虑，认为每个人都需要考虑这一点，并把真实和虚假视为同等有效，

sentences.en: just because this person has a feeling about it, you know, that is an absurd proposition.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为这个人对此有某种感觉，那是一个荒谬的命题。

sentences.en: Yet, you know, most people do this all the time and just so that they don't have to feel mean.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数人总是这样做，仅仅是为了不让自己感到刻薄。

sentences.en: And I'm not advocating when I'm saying this for you to pass self-righteous judgment or throw out discernment and humility.
sentences.zh: 我这么说并不是在提倡你进行自以为是的评判，也不是要你抛弃洞察力和谦逊。

sentences.en: The opposite of truth is not lies, but it's certainty.
sentences.zh: 真理的对立面不是谎言，而是确定性。

sentences.en: And judgment is unhealthy when it comes from an unresolved superiority complex.
sentences.zh: 当评判源于未解决的优越感时，它是不健康的。

sentences.en: You know, when you have an unresolved superiority complex, you judge other people all the time just so that you don't have to feel inferior.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你有一种未解决的优越感时，你总是评判别人，只是为了不让自己感到自卑。

sentences.en: And a lot of times people who don't want to pass judgment, they've been hurt by someone like that, and they're like, well, I'm not going to be like them, so I'm just going to
sentences.zh: 很多时候，那些不想评判别人的人，是因为曾被这样的人伤害过，他们会想：“好吧，我才不要像他们那样，所以我干脆

sentences.en: not admit reality to myself.
sentences.zh: 不对自己承认现实。”

sentences.en: Well, that's a little bit too far.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这有点走极端了。

sentences.en: If reality is hurting somebody's feelings, that's not your fault.
sentences.zh: 如果现实伤害了某人的感情，那不是你的错。

sentences.en: Judgment is a part of mature adulthood.
sentences.zh: 评判是成熟成年生活的一部分。

sentences.en: When we allow our intuition to tell us that some things are simply wrong, no matter how widely accepted or traditional they are, they just are not right.
sentences.zh: 当我们允许直觉告诉我们某些事情就是错误的，无论它们被多么广泛地接受或多么传统，它们就是不对。

sentences.en: Moral certainty is one of the first stones on the path to fanaticism.
sentences.zh: 道德上的绝对确定性是通往狂热之路上的第一块基石。

sentences.en: So, you know, I'm not saying that you should never doubt yourself, but having just a moral clarity, that's an essential ingredient to mental health because you're just able to
sentences.zh: 所以，我不是说你不应该怀疑自己，但拥有道德清晰度是心理健康的重要组成部分，因为你能够

sentences.en: know clearly what you know and apply the same standard that you have for yourself to others and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 清楚地知道自己所知，并对自己和他人应用相同的标准，反之亦然。

sentences.en: Now, we can never wield judgment or discernment as a tool that helps us make healthy decisions
sentences.zh: 现在，如果我们每次开始注意到别人有时表现得很糟糕时，就被内疚感淹没，

sentences.en: and avoid destructive paths if we get overwhelmed by guilt every time we start to notice that
sentences.zh: 我们就永远无法将评判或洞察力作为一种工具，来帮助我们做出健康的决定并避免破坏性的道路。

sentences.en: other people are behaving badly sometimes, and even people we love or people that helped us or all the reasons that we use to not notice that.
sentences.zh: 即使是那些我们爱的人，或者帮助过我们的人，或者我们用来不去注意这些事实的所有理由。

sentences.en: We just don't let ourselves see it.
sentences.zh: 我们只是不让自己看到它。

sentences.en: Many times when we talk about psychology, politics, religion, or family honesty, or family honestly and openly, it makes people feel icky or guilty.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，当我们谈论心理学、政治、宗教或家庭诚实——或者说家庭坦诚开放时，这会让人们感到不舒服或内疚。

sentences.en: And this is because most people do not want to know what they think when it comes to these arenas of life or they don't want to accept what they already know.
sentences.zh: 这是因为大多数人不想知道自己在这些生活领域中的真实想法，或者他们不想接受他们已经知道的事实。

sentences.en: So, you know, Carl Jung, we talk about it a lot, the psychologist, he calls this the shadow,
sentences.zh: 所以，卡尔·荣格——我们经常谈论的心理学家——他称之为“阴影”，

sentences.en: the slippery half-truth that we tell ourselves so that we don't have to accept the whole truth that always walks behind us.
sentences.zh: 那是我们告诉自己的滑头的半真半假的话，这样我们就不必接受那始终跟在我们身后的全部真相。

sentences.en: And often this is because of trauma, this kind of dishonesty, because we don't want to hurt others by criticizing them because we were hurt as children.
sentences.zh: 这通常是因为创伤，这种不诚实是因为我们不想通过批评来伤害他人，因为我们小时候曾受过伤害。

sentences.en: We don't want to be like the abuser, so we decide that we're either going to play victim or we're going to enable a victim.
sentences.zh: 我们不想成为施虐者，所以我们决定要么扮演受害者，要么助长受害者。

sentences.en: And the second one, enabling the victim, is more common than somebody who has kind of a victim mindset or like a personality disorder.
sentences.zh: 而后者，即助长受害者，比那种有受害者心态或人格障碍的人更常见。

sentences.en: And that's one of the ways that we don't notice that trauma is still running our lives.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们没有注意到创伤仍在掌控我们生活的方式之一。

sentences.en: You know, we just make it easier to believe that everything is our fault or enable other people's bad behavior by refusing to point out unhealthy or self-destructive tendencies
sentences.zh: 我们只是让自己更容易相信一切都是自己的错，或者通过拒绝指出他人的不健康或自我毁灭倾向来助长他人的不良行为，

sentences.en: in others, which as an adult is your job, you know, to point out to people who you love
sentences.zh: 而作为成年人，你的工作就是指出你所爱的人

sentences.en: and are not trying to enable when they're being unhealthy and when they're being self-destructive.
sentences.zh: 在他们表现得不健康和自我毁灭时，如果你不想助长他们的话。

sentences.en: But that starts with you being honest about that in your own head.
sentences.zh: 但这始于你对自己内心的诚实。

sentences.en: So if we're afraid of judgment, we think that we can avoid it, but instead our avoidance causes more probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们害怕评判，我们以为可以逃避它，但实际上我们的逃避导致了更多问题。

sentences.en: Instead of having frank conversations about where our beliefs diverge from others, we try and control others through praise.
sentences.zh: 我们没有就我们的信仰与他人分歧之处进行坦诚的对话，而是试图通过赞美来控制他人。

sentences.en: You know, telling somebody that we love them because they make good grades is just as damaging as saying, I won't love you if you make bad grades.
sentences.zh: 告诉某人我们爱他们是因为他们成绩好，这和说“如果你成绩不好我就不爱你了”一样具有破坏性。

sentences.en: They're kind of the same statement.
sentences.zh: 它们本质上是同一种陈述。

sentences.en: You know, telling someone that, you know, we like them because they do certain things is still judgment.
sentences.zh: 告诉某人我们喜欢他们是因为他们做了某些事，这仍然是评判。

sentences.en: Sidra and Hal Stone in their book, Embracing Ourselves, they talk about how most judgment
sentences.zh: Sidra 和 Hal Stone 在他们的书《拥抱我们自己》(Embracing Ourselves) 中谈到，大多数评判

sentences.en: is passed through positive statements, it's passed through praise, and that still does damage to children when they show up in therapy as adults.
sentences.zh: 是通过积极的陈述、通过赞美传递出来的，当这些孩子成年后出现在治疗室时，这仍然会对他们造成伤害。

sentences.en: So other times, and that's because it makes the love sound conditional, and then children
sentences.zh: 所以，这是因为这让爱听起来是有条件的，然后孩子们

sentences.en: are just as afraid as if you told them that you weren't proud of them or, you know, something else.
sentences.zh: 会感到恐惧，就像你告诉他们你为他们感到骄傲，或者其他什么一样。

sentences.en: So other times, this unconscious fear of holding authority or passing judgment blinds us to the judgments that we do hold and pass all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以，这种对掌握权威或进行评判的无意识恐惧，有时会让我们对自己一直持有并实施的评判视而不见。

sentences.en: And so many people are unaware that they hold judgment because they have identified with it for so long as just a part of who they are that, and sometimes these individuals grew
sentences.zh: 很多人并没有意识到他们持有评判，因为他们已经认同它太久了，把它当作自己的一部分。有时这些人成长于

sentences.en: up in families where they may not have even realized that they were being constantly, you know, passively criticized.
sentences.zh: 家庭中，他们甚至可能没有意识到自己一直在被持续地、被动地批评。

sentences.en: And that's because the places where we were taught to criticize ourselves, and often we hide an unhealed wound there, they're where we don't notice that what we're saying to
sentences.zh: 这是因为我们被教导批评自己的地方，往往隐藏着未愈合的伤口，在那里我们没有注意到我们对

sentences.en: our children or to someone else is damaging.
sentences.zh: 孩子或其他人所说的话是有害的。

sentences.en: And so the things are people who we judge very intensely, and they have potential to become important teachers for us because we can learn why we need to other this person,
sentences.zh: 所以，那些我们强烈评判的人，他们有潜力成为我们重要的老师，因为我们可以学习为什么我们需要将这个人“他者化”，

sentences.en: why we need to judge them.
sentences.zh: 为什么我们需要评判他们。

sentences.en: And you can mindfully find out if that is something where you have a trauma and an unconscious bias

sentences.en: And you're just holding authority that you have to pass, you know, a knowledge of right and are hung over your life.

sentences.zh: 所以，当你在家庭治疗中告诉某人他们的行为如何影响你时，你经常会

sentences.en: That they occur.

sentences.en: And there's a place where they're not being honest and they're not being self-defeating.
sentences.zh: 但在某个地方，他们并不诚实，他们并没有在自我挫败。

sentences.en: They're being self-defeating.
sentences.zh: 他们是在自我挫败。

sentences.en: They're running from who they are.
sentences.zh: 他们在逃避真实的自己。

sentences.en: And it's not really my part to make him deal with unless he asks me for the help.
sentences.zh: 除非他向我求助，否则让他去处理这些并不是我的职责。

sentences.en: And a lot of times when you're trying to find out if people want that help, you can just tell them how their behavior makes you feel.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，当你试图弄清楚人们是否想要这种帮助时，你可以直接告诉他们他们的行为让你有什么感觉。

sentences.en: You know, when you do that, I kind of feel like I don't want to be around you because I just am not able, you know, whatever it is, you know.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你这样做的时候，我感觉不想和你待在一起，因为我实在无法，你知道，不管是什么原因，你知道。

sentences.en: And they can either attack you and say, well, that you should just get firm up and you're weak or that's outrageous.
sentences.zh: 他们要么攻击你，说，你应该坚强一点，你太软弱了，或者这太离谱了。

sentences.en: And then, you know, they don't want the help there.
sentences.zh: 那么，你知道，他们并不想要那里的帮助。

sentences.en: Yeah, or maybe they say, oh, I didn't know I was doing that.
sentences.zh: 是的，或者也许他们会说，哦，我不知道我在那样做。

sentences.en: And you've got your foot in the door.
sentences.zh: 那你就有机会进一步沟通了。

sentences.en: You know, a lot of people ask for help, but they're not really asking for help.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很多人寻求帮助，但他们并不是真的在寻求帮助。

sentences.en: You know, the person that's just like, why would he do this?
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种只会问“他为什么要这样做？”的人。

sentences.en: Well, I don't know, because you set him up to you and then you enabled him and then you, well, why would you say that to me?
sentences.zh: 嗯，我不知道，因为你纵容了他，然后你又助长了他，然后你，嗯，你为什么要那样对我说话？

sentences.en: That person's asking you for help, but they're not really asking for help.
sentences.zh: 那个人是在向你寻求帮助，但他们并不是真的在寻求帮助。

sentences.en: And then there's other people who are just like, I don't know why I feel this way.
sentences.zh: 还有其他人只是说，我不知道我为什么会有这种感觉。

sentences.en: I mean, they're not saying, help me, help me.
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们没有说，帮帮我，帮帮我。

sentences.en: But there's an openness to change.
sentences.zh: 但他们对改变持开放态度。

sentences.en: And I think that's what Adler means.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是阿德勒的意思。

sentences.en: He doesn't mean that you don't help anyone unless they walk up and say like, please, sir, may I have some help from you?
sentences.zh: 他并不是说除非有人走过来请求说，先生，请帮帮我，否则你就不要帮助任何人。

sentences.en: He just means that you wait until people are open to growth.
sentences.zh: 他只是说，你要等到人们对成长持开放态度时再介入。

sentences.en: And you continue to invite them there, but you can't force them there.
sentences.zh: 你可以继续邀请他们，但你不能强迫他们。

sentences.en: You know, a long time ago, I had a patient in therapy and they told me, my boyfriend keeps cheating on me and I keep forgiving him.
sentences.zh: 你知道，很久以前，我有一位治疗中的病人，他们告诉我，我的男朋友一直在出轨，而我一直在原谅他。

sentences.en: And I was like, well, could you not forgive your boyfriend?
sentences.zh: 我就问，嗯，你能不能不原谅你的男朋友？

sentences.en: Like, do you have the choice if he cheats on you to not forgive him?
sentences.zh: 比如，如果他出轨了，你有选择不原谅他的权利吗？

sentences.en: And they said, oh no, I couldn't do that.
sentences.zh: 他们说，哦不，我做不到。

sentences.en: I have to ignore the bad behavior and I have to take him back or I have to tell him I forgive him.
sentences.zh: 我必须忽视这种糟糕的行为，我必须接受他，或者我必须告诉他我原谅他了。

sentences.en: And I told the person, you know, that's fine, but that is not what forgiveness is.
sentences.zh: 我告诉那个人，你知道，这没关系，但这并不是原谅的含义。

sentences.en: That's just enabling because forgiveness is a choice.
sentences.zh: 那只是在纵容，因为原谅是一种选择。

sentences.en: And if you can't not do it, then you're not doing something noble by doing it.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法选择不原谅，那么你这样做并不是什么高尚的行为。

sentences.en: You're just doing the only thing that you know how to do.
sentences.zh: 你只是在做你唯一知道该怎么做的事情。

sentences.en: So, you know, we should have grace and forgiveness for our own and others' mistakes.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，我们应该对自己和他人的错误保持宽容和原谅。

sentences.en: Judgment should not make you feel like a god by proxy.
sentences.zh: 评判不应该让你觉得自己像个代理上帝。

sentences.en: Forgiveness comes after honesty, though.
sentences.zh: 不过，原谅建立在诚实之后。

sentences.en: You can't forgive me for the crime that I committed and I'm still committing and I plan on continuing to commit because I haven't asked for help yet.
sentences.zh: 你不能原谅我犯下的罪行，而我还在继续犯，并且计划继续犯下去，因为我还没有寻求帮助。

sentences.en: You know, that's not how grace works.
sentences.zh: 你知道，恩典不是那样运作的。

sentences.en: Continuing to let somebody off the hook for behavior they refuse to change might make us feel less icky, but it also means that we don't have integrity.
sentences.zh: 继续让某人逃避他们拒绝改变的行为，可能会让我们感觉不那么难受，但这也意味着我们缺乏正直。

sentences.en: You know, the best predictor of future behavior is always going to be past behavior.
sentences.zh: 你知道，预测未来行为的最佳指标永远是过去的行为。

sentences.en: And if I will not admit that I have a problem, then I likely am not going to change and you are within your rights as an adult to point that out to me.
sentences.zh: 如果我不承认我有问题，那么我可能就不会改变，而作为成年人，你有权向我指出这一点。

sentences.en: When people make objective statements of fact about you or other people, then that cannot by definition be mean or hateful, you know, unless they're cherry-picking something just
sentences.zh: 当人们对你或其他人做出客观的事实陈述时，那在定义上就不可能是刻薄或仇恨的，你知道，除非他们只是为了伤害某人而挑三拣四。

sentences.en: to hurt somebody.
sentences.zh: 人们陈述现实并不是，它没有道德属性。

sentences.en: People putting reality out isn't, it doesn't have a morality.
sentences.zh: 现实就是它本来的样子。

sentences.en: Reality is just what it is.
sentences.zh: 然后我们，在这些限制之内，试图找出如何在这些限制内行事。

sentences.en: And then we, with the limitations of that, try and figure out how to act within those limitations.
sentences.zh: 这就是道德。

sentences.en: And that is morality.
sentences.zh: 你知道，客观陈述只有真假之分。

sentences.en: You know, objective statements are just true or false.
sentences.zh: 它们不可能是刻薄的，也不可能是仇恨的。

sentences.en: They can't be mean and they can't be hateful.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，当这些陈述涉及某人心理中具有威胁性的模式或投射时，它们确实令人不安，但它们仍然是真实的。

sentences.en: And, you know, it's true that when those statements are about patterns or projections from someone's psychology that's threatening, but it's still real.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们的思维方式。

sentences.en: That's the way that they think.
sentences.zh: 这就是他们已经证明的思维方式，而且很可能会继续下去。

sentences.en: It's the way that they have demonstrated that they think and likely will continue to.
sentences.zh: 所以，我看到人们最难接受现实的地方之一，就是当有人诚实且不带评判地指出朋友或家人思考时的模式和偏好时，其他人就会生气。

sentences.en: And so one of the places where I see, you know, people have the hardest time accepting reality is when people point out honestly and without judgment, you know, the patterns
sentences.zh: 这在家庭治疗中经常发生，那些不想被重新引导的人，或者宁愿纵容某人的人，他们会发火，因为他们不想承认那些模式是真实的。

sentences.en: and the preferences with which a friend or family member thinks and everyone else gets angry.
sentences.zh: 模式是最容易被忽视的事情之一，因为，是的，他们昨天就这样做了。

sentences.en: And that happens in family therapy or the people who don't want that redirected at them or would rather enable somebody, they get mad because they don't want to admit that those
sentences.zh: 他们上周也这样做过。

sentences.en: patterns are real.
sentences.zh: 他们上个月也这样做过。

sentences.en: And patterns are one of the easiest things to ignore because, yeah, they did it yesterday.
sentences.zh: 他们每周都这样做。

sentences.en: They did it the week before.
sentences.zh: 但你怎么知道他们未来会那样做呢？

sentences.en: They did it the month before.
sentences.zh: 你太傲慢了。

sentences.en: They've done it every week.
sentences.zh: 嗯，并非如此，因为心理学的运作方式就是通过这些模式和偏好，你知道，在非常基础的层面上。

sentences.en: But how do you know they're going to act that way in the future?
sentences.zh: 所以你所做的事情，你所认同的价值观，它们都在说明你是什么样的人。

sentences.en: That's so arrogant of you.
sentences.zh: 怎么可能不是呢？

sentences.en: Well, it's not because the way that psychology works is through these patterns and preferences, you know, on a very base level.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们不是随机选择我们的神学。

sentences.en: So the things that you do, the values that you identify with, they say something about you.
sentences.zh: 我们不是随机选择我们的哲学。

sentences.en: How could they not?
sentences.zh: 我们不是随机选择我们的政治立场。

sentences.en: You know, we don't pick our theology.
sentences.zh: 我们不是随机选择我们的个人信仰。

sentences.en: We don't pick our philosophies.
sentences.zh: 我们这样做是我们自身心理和未解决创伤的投射。

sentences.en: We don't pick our politics.
sentences.zh: 你不能说，嗯，他们从小被教导或被告知要相信那个，或者，你知道，

sentences.en: We don't pick our personal beliefs randomly.
sentences.zh: 就让某人逃避责任，因为我们必须为自己的生活和所做的事情负责。

sentences.en: We do that as a projection of our own psychology and our unresolved trauma.
sentences.zh: 如果在你爱的人身上存在一种不健康的、无意识的过程，那么如果你忽视它，你就不是在诚实地对待。

sentences.en: And you can't say, well, they were raised to or they were told to believe that or, you know,
sentences.zh: 你是在纵容。

sentences.en: to let somebody off the hook because we have to be accountable for our own lives and the things that we do.
sentences.zh: 如果你攻击那些仅仅指出你想要忽视的关于他人的事实的人，你也是在纵容你自己。

sentences.en: And if there is an unhealthy, unconscious process in someone you love, then you're not being honest if you ignore it.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果某人已经成为一种不健康信仰体系的延伸，或者，你知道，如果他们的行为因为他们被告知要相信的东西而变得不健康，那绝对仍然是那个人的错。

sentences.en: You are enabling.
sentences.zh: 改变它是他们的责任，因为这不可能是其他任何人的责任。

sentences.en: And you're enabling yourself if you attack others that are simply pointing out facts that you want to ignore about other people.
sentences.zh: 他们是唯一能寻求帮助的人。

sentences.en: So if someone has become an extension of an unhealthy belief system or, you know, if their
sentences.zh: 他们是唯一能接受帮助的人。

sentences.en: actions become unhealthy because of something that they were told to believe, that is still absolutely that person's fault.
sentences.zh: 他们是唯一能成长和改变的人。

sentences.en: And it is their responsibility to change it because it can't be anyone else's responsibility.
sentences.zh: 没有其他人能为他们做到这一点。

sentences.en: They are the only one that can ask for help.
sentences.zh: 所以这还能是谁的错呢？

sentences.en: They are the only one that can accept the help.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们的行为、我们的信仰、我们的自我形象、宗教信仰，你知道，甚至是或者特别是在不同人选择的治疗方式，它们都是我们自身心理的投射。

sentences.en: They are the only one that can grow and change.
sentences.zh: 你知道，怎么可能不是呢？

sentences.en: No one else can do that for them.
sentences.zh: 是我们选择了它们。

sentences.en: So who else's fault is that supposed to be?
sentences.zh: 如果你在泥潭里打转，试图从理智上为一些你在情感上不想面对的事情辩护，你就是在逃避和纵容。

sentences.en: You know, our actions, our beliefs, our self-image, religious beliefs, you know, even or especially
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些模式是真实的。

sentences.en: the modalities of therapy that different people pick, they're projections of our own psychology.
sentences.zh: 这就是我做这份工作的方式。

sentences.en: You know, how could they not be?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们选择它们。

sentences.en: We pick them.
sentences.zh: 如果你在泥潭里打转，试图从理智上为一些你在情感上不想面对的事情辩护，你就是在逃避和纵容。

sentences.en: If you're spinning your tires in the mud trying to justify intellectually something that you don't want to face emotionally, you're being avoidant and enabling.
sentences.zh: 你知道，这些模式是真实的。

sentences.en: You know, these patterns are real.
sentences.zh: 这就是我做这份工作的方式。

sentences.en: That's how I do my job.
sentences.zh: 这就是我做这份工作的方式。

sentences.en: You know, if you can't refute the truth of what someone challenging you is saying, notice where your emotional self wants to say, yeah, but, you know, that's the beginning seed of
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，如果你无法反驳挑战你的人所说的事实，请留意你内心深处想要说“是，但是……”的地方，你知道，那正是

sentences.en: avoidance that leads us to enable the brokenness of this world.
sentences.zh: 逃避的种子，它导致我们纵容这个世界的破碎。

sentences.en: It's what leads us to do and contribute to evil.
sentences.zh: 正是这种逃避导致我们去作恶并助纣为虐。

sentences.en: And there are many more people, hundreds of people contributing to evil for every one person that actually does the material action.
sentences.zh: 而且，每有一个真正付诸行动的人，就有更多的人——成百上千的人——在为恶行推波助澜。

sentences.en: The other people are doing the avoidance that allows it to take place.
sentences.zh: 其他人则在进行着让恶行得以发生的逃避行为。

sentences.en: So face this stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以，直面这些吧。

sentences.en: You know, watch your own reactions and notice where it is hard for you to not attack others when they state facts.
sentences.zh: 你知道，审视你自己的反应，留意当你面对他人陈述事实时，你为何难以克制攻击他们的冲动。

sentences.en: You know, that is where your psychology is still operating like a child's.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那正是你心理运作还像个孩子一样的地方。

sentences.en: And if you hear yourself making excuses for someone, when someone points out something that is simply true, then it's time for that part of you to grow up.
sentences.zh: 如果你听到自己在为某人找借口，而对方指出的事情明明是事实，那么你内心那部分是时候长大了。

sentences.en: You know, fighting evil starts with your ability to look into your own eye.
sentences.zh: 你知道，对抗邪恶始于你审视自己内心的能力。

sentences.en: Most religious traditions, they start when they're trying to challenge the ego.
sentences.zh: 大多数宗教传统，在试图挑战自我（ego）时便已发端。

sentences.en: And then later they're co-opted by those that want to enable the ego and the self-image as it exists right now, not what it could be.
sentences.zh: 但后来它们被那些想要维护现有自我和形象的人所利用，而不是去追求它本可以成为的样子。

sentences.en: So, you know, don't misuse your own spiritual or philosophical tradition to this end.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，不要为了这个目的而滥用你自己的精神或哲学传统。

sentences.en: Really don't abuse your psychotherapy modality to that end.
sentences.zh: 真的，不要为了这个目的而滥用你的心理治疗方式。

sentences.en: But that's a whole other conversation.
sentences.zh: 但这又是另一个话题了。

sentences.en: You know, in relationship counseling, the biggest predictor of success is not the size of the problem that the couple or the, you know, polycule or the family is facing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，在关系咨询中，成功的最大预测指标并不是这对伴侣，或者你知道，多角恋群体或家庭所面临的问题有多大。

sentences.en: Um, you'll see giant problems like drug addiction or serial adultery and that a couple heals from.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你会看到像毒瘾或连环出轨这样巨大的问题，但伴侣最终却能从中治愈。

sentences.en: And you'll also see small problems like avoidance and white lies and that end a marriage.
sentences.zh: 你也会看到像逃避和善意的谎言这样的小问题，却最终导致了婚姻破裂。

sentences.en: And the biggest predictor of success is whether or not all parties are willing to accurately label the problem and agree that it should change.
sentences.zh: 而成功的最大预测指标是，所有相关方是否愿意准确地界定问题，并同意做出改变。

sentences.en: You know, when you face your own shame, remember that it is not the size of the error, but the elaborateness of the defense mechanisms that you enable.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你面对自己的羞耻感时，请记住，重要的不是错误的程度，而是你所启用的防御机制有多复杂。

sentences.en: Evil is created when we rationalize and avoid labeling bad behavior so that we can insulate ourselves from the need to change.
sentences.zh: 当我们合理化并避免给不良行为贴上标签，以便让自己免于改变的需要时，邪恶便产生了。

sentences.en: We all have the responsibility to change.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有改变的责任。

sentences.en: And if someone willfully chooses to make themselves and the world a worse place, be honest about
sentences.zh: 如果有人执意选择让自己和世界变得更糟，请诚实地面对

sentences.en: that fact, defend their soul's potential, but not their behavior, not even their behavior.
sentences.zh: 那个事实，捍卫他们灵魂的潜能，但不要捍卫他们的行为，甚至连他们的行为也不要捍卫。

sentences.en: If it comes from trauma and don't refuse, don't defend their refusal to actualize their potential.
sentences.zh: 如果这是源于创伤，不要拒绝，也不要为他们拒绝实现自身潜能的行为辩护。

sentences.en: If somebody tells you not to speak ill of family or ill of the dead, or, you know, a politician, a celebrity, tell them that you would rather be honeSt.
sentences.zh: 如果有人告诉你不要说家人、死者，或者你知道，政客、名人的坏话，告诉他们你宁愿诚实。

sentences.en: If not authentic honesty, what else do we have?
sentences.zh: 如果不是真实的诚实，我们还能拥有什么？

sentences.en: You know, really what other personal freedom do we have?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们到底还有什么个人自由？

sentences.en: They all start with that one.
sentences.zh: 它们都始于这一点。

sentences.en: Maya Angelou was a wise woman, but when she said, when people tell you who you are, believe them, she was talking about challenging your ego and the manners and the traditions that
sentences.zh: 玛雅·安杰卢（Maya Angelou）是一位睿智的女性，但当她说“当人们告诉你他们是谁时，请相信他们”时，她谈论的是挑战你的自我（ego），以及那些

sentences.en: you were told made you noble and good, so that when you saw somebody act against your values, you understood who they were and you just let yourself know that.
sentences.zh: 被告知让你变得高尚和善良的礼仪和传统，这样当你看到有人违背你的价值观行事时，你就能明白他们是谁，并让自己意识到这一点。

sentences.en: But a lot of these quotes about psychology get co-opted on Instagram and used to defend bad behavior.
sentences.zh: 但很多关于心理学的名言在 Instagram 上被挪用，用来为不良行为辩护。

sentences.en: And one of Maya Angelou's that gets misused is, people don't remember what you said, they remember how you made them feel.
sentences.zh: 玛雅·安杰卢被误用的一句名言是：“人们不记得你说过什么，他们记得你让他们感受到了什么。”

sentences.en: Some variation of that will pop up on your Instagram.
sentences.zh: 这句话的某种变体总会出现在你的 Instagram 上。

sentences.en: If somebody doesn't remember anything that you said, and they think you were responsible for how they feel, they have a personality disorder.
sentences.zh: 如果有人什么都不记得你说过什么，却认为你该为他们的感受负责，那他们患有人格障碍。

sentences.en: Write them off.
sentences.zh: 别理他们。

sentences.en: Other people's emotional reactions to things that you didn't say because they can't remember are not your fault.
sentences.zh: 别人对你没说过的话产生的负面情绪反应，因为他们记不住，这不是你的错。

sentences.en: Or things that you said as an objective statement that they turn into a subjective statement.
sentences.zh: 或者你作为客观陈述的话，被他们转变成了主观陈述。

sentences.en: That also is not your fault either.
sentences.zh: 那也不是你的错。

sentences.en: So stop quoting Maya Angelou on Instagram when you want other people to take responsibility for your emotion.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你想要别人为你的情绪负责时，别再在 Instagram 上引用玛雅·安杰卢的话了。

sentences.en: Your emotional reality is your job.
sentences.zh: 你的情感现实是你自己的工作。

sentences.en: It is your job to remember and think about the points that others make.
sentences.zh: 记住并思考他人提出的观点是你的工作。

sentences.en: Not to blame other people for how those points make you feel and then forget them.
sentences.zh: 而不是因为这些观点让你产生某种感受就去责怪他人，然后把它们抛之脑后。

sentences.en: That is not what Maya Angelou meant.
sentences.zh: 那不是玛雅·安杰卢的原意。

sentences.en: That is how her quote is used all over the internet.
sentences.zh: 但她的名言在互联网上就是这样被使用的。

sentences.en: I know that trauma plays a part in our beliefs about ourselves and what we do.
sentences.zh: 我知道创伤在我们对自己的信念和行为中起着作用。

sentences.en: I know that it informs religion and philosophy and taste and culture, and I know that there are reasons that people make the choices that they do, but we are the ones responsible
sentences.zh: 我知道它影响着宗教、哲学、品味和文化，我也知道人们做出选择是有原因的，但我们才是对自己生活和发展负责的人。

sentences.en: for our own life and development.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们的人生是我们自己选择的总和，作为朋友、家人或治疗师，如果你假装事实并非如此，那对任何人都没有好处。

sentences.en: Ultimately, our lives are the sum total of our own choices, and as a friend, as a family member, as a therapist, you are not doing anyone a favor by pretending that that is not the
sentences.zh: 归根结底，我们的人生是我们自己选择的总和，作为朋友、家人或治疗师，如果你假装事实并非如此，那对任何人都没有好处。

sentences.en: case.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: Patients know that on some level, before they come to see you, that they want to grow.
sentences.zh: 病人在来见你之前，在某种程度上就知道他们想要成长。

sentences.en: Even if they fight you during the growth process, they know that, and ultimately, patients will leave if you fail to point out as a therapist that their life is their job.
sentences.zh: 即使他们在成长过程中与你抗争，他们也知道这一点，最终，如果你作为治疗师未能指出他们的人生是他们自己的责任，病人就会离开。

sentences.en: People come to therapy for many reasons, but underneath all of those choices, we are really only ever making one choice.
sentences.zh: 人们出于各种原因寻求心理治疗，但在所有这些选择之下，我们其实只做了一个选择。

sentences.en: Do you go into the parts of yourself that you're afraid of?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意深入探索自己内心恐惧的部分？

sentences.en: Do you face them?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意直面它们？

sentences.en: And do you grow and change?
sentences.zh: 你是否愿意成长和改变？

sentences.en: You know, faced with that choice directly, most people will choose to run.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当直接面对这个选择时，大多数人会选择逃跑。

sentences.en: And I understand the tragedy of that, but that does not make that decision or its consequences any less real.
sentences.zh: 我理解其中的悲剧性，但这并不会让那个决定或其后果变得不那么真实。

sentences.en: Most biographies are a tragedy, but that is not your fault.
sentences.zh: 大多数人的传记都是一场悲剧，但这并不是你的错。

sentences.en: The only biography that you have control over is your own autobiography.
sentences.zh: 你唯一能掌控的传记是你自己的自传。

sentences.en: Everyone has the ability to heal and change.
sentences.zh: 每个人都有治愈和改变的能力。

sentences.en: You are not doing yourself or others any favors when you make excuses or make an argument that lack of growth is just part of someone's implicit nature.
sentences.zh: 当你找借口或争辩说缺乏成长只是某人内在天性的一部分时，这对你自己或他人都没有任何好处。

sentences.en: Or, that's just how she is, or that's just how I am.
sentences.zh: 或者说，“她就是那样”，或者“我就是这样”。

sentences.en: No, it's not.
sentences.zh: 不，不是这样的。

sentences.en: That's just how you chose to behave, and you can stop choosing to be that way.
sentences.zh: 那只是你选择的行为方式，你可以停止选择那样做。

sentences.en: If that makes you feel icky, sit.
sentences.zh: 如果这让你感到不舒服，坐下来。

sentences.en: Sit with it, and then go to therapy.
sentences.zh: 静下心来感受它，然后去接受心理治疗。

sentences.en: Those people, or you, could change if you want to.
sentences.zh: 那些人，或者你自己，如果愿意的话，是可以改变的。

sentences.en: You're not doing them any favors by indulging the belief that they can't change, and in order to make them feel better, telling them that that's just part of their nature, and
sentences.zh: 你纵容他们无法改变的信念，为了让他们感觉好受一点而告诉他们那只是他们天性的一部分，这对他们没有任何好处，

sentences.en: that we're all built different, and that this is just something that implicitly is who they are.
sentences.zh: 而且认为我们生来就不同，这只是他们内在固有的东西。

sentences.en: It's not.
sentences.zh: 并不是。

sentences.en: It's a choice, and you change if you want to.
sentences.zh: 这是一种选择，如果你想改变，你就能改变。

sentences.en: Maybe they don't want to, but don't pretend that they can.
sentences.zh: 也许他们不想改变，但不要假装他们做不到。

sentences.en: The parts of ourselves that defeat our authentic self should make us feel bad, and in order to feel bad enough to change, we have to feel that anxiety.
sentences.zh: 我们内心那些击败真实自我的部分应该让我们感到难受，为了难受到足以改变，我们必须感受到那种焦虑。

sentences.en: That's why things like AA say you have to let somebody hit rock bottom, because when there's nothing else that they can blame for their situation except themselves, then they
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么像戒酒互助会（AA）这样的组织说你必须让一个人跌入谷底，因为当他们除了自己之外无法将现状归咎于任何人时，他们就必须向内审视。

sentences.en: have to look inward.
sentences.zh: 他们就必须向内审视。

sentences.en: And a lot of times, substance abuse will take away the ability to look inward, because everything
sentences.zh: 而且很多时候，药物滥用会剥夺向内审视的能力，因为一切都是向外的，

sentences.en: is outward, faced with this survival of, I cannot feel good on the inside, so I have to look outside for something that makes me feel good.
sentences.zh: 面对这种生存状态：“我在内心无法感到良好，所以我必须向外寻找能让我感觉良好的东西。”

sentences.en: And a ton of the time, you don't have the option not to do that in substance abuse until there's just nothing left.
sentences.zh: 很多时候，在药物滥用中，你别无选择，只能这样做，直到一无所有。

sentences.en: And that's why that concept exists.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么会有这个概念。

sentences.en: You know, that anxiety that propels us towards change, if we don't ignore it, if we don't turn it off, if we don't drug it, eventually it will help us grow.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那种推动我们改变的焦虑，如果我们不忽视它，不压抑它，不靠药物麻痹它，最终它会帮助我们成长。

sentences.en: But don't do the enabling thing by turning that anxiety off by telling other people that it's fine when it's not fine.
sentences.zh: 但不要通过告诉别人“没关系”来压抑那种焦虑，从而进行纵容，明明事实并非如此。

sentences.en: You know, the reason that people who hurt you did that was because they were afraid to face their own fears.
sentences.zh: 你知道，伤害你的人之所以那样做，是因为他们害怕面对自己的恐惧。

sentences.en: Your only choice is to face your own fear.
sentences.zh: 你唯一的选择就是面对你自己的恐惧。

sentences.en: When you don't believe that you can change, then constructive criticism is an attack, because all the intonations of what you could be are a reminder that that is not who you are
sentences.zh: 当你认为自己无法改变时，建设性的批评就是一种攻击，因为所有关于你“可以成为什么样”的暗示，都在提醒你，那不是你现在的样子。

sentences.en: right now.
sentences.zh: 那不是你现在的样子。

sentences.en: If this is all that I think I can be, then all I can take from the most constructive of criticism is that what I am is wrong.
sentences.zh: 如果这就是我所认为的全部，那么我从最建设性的批评中只能得出结论：现在的我是错误的。

sentences.en: It is wrong because I was made to believe that what I am is all I can be.
sentences.zh: 它是错误的，因为我被灌输了一种信念，即现在的我就是我所能成为的一切。

sentences.en: In screenwriting, they have this concept that the antagonist cannot change.
sentences.zh: 在编剧领域，有一个概念是反派不能改变。

sentences.en: The protagonist changes, and the antagonist is somebody who gets stuck somewhere on the path to self-actualization, and they can't go past that point, so they try and stop other
sentences.zh: 主角会改变，而反派是那些在自我实现的道路上被困住的人，他们无法超越那个点，所以他们试图阻止其他人超越它，或者攻击他们。

sentences.en: people who go past it or they attack them.
sentences.zh: 他们试图阻止其他人超越它，或者攻击他们。

sentences.en: You know, the antagonist has no possibility of change.
sentences.zh: 你知道，反派没有改变的可能性。

sentences.en: The shark from Jaws doesn't change.
sentences.zh: 《大白鲨》里的鲨鱼不会改变。

sentences.en: The alien from Alien doesn't change.
sentences.zh: 《异形》里的外星生物不会改变。

sentences.en: The hitman in the country desert movie doesn't change.
sentences.zh: 乡村沙漠电影里的杀手不会改变。

sentences.en: And as soon as they start looking inward, as soon as they start changing, then they are starting to become a co-protagonist in the movie.
sentences.zh: 而一旦他们开始向内审视，一旦他们开始改变，他们就开始成为电影里的共同主角了。

sentences.en: So, you know, when I start to change, I become the protagonist, and everyone has that option.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，当我开始改变时，我就成了主角，每个人都有这个选择。

sentences.en: For real change to take place, the other party has to understand themselves as a series of parts and decisions.
sentences.zh: 为了实现真正的改变，对方必须将自己理解为一系列部分和决定的集合。

sentences.en: You know, who they authentically are is not bad, and they have to get that.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们真实的样子并不坏，他们必须明白这一点。

sentences.en: Just because my behavior was bad does not mean that I am bad.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为我的行为很糟糕，并不意味着我这个人很糟糕。

sentences.en: Behavior is a choice, and I can change.
sentences.zh: 行为是一种选择，我可以改变。

sentences.en: Most people will never know who they are, and that is a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 大多数人永远不会知道自己是谁，这是一种悲剧。

sentences.en: They will never face the parts of themselves that they are afraid of, and in avoiding them, they will project them onto you and onto me.
sentences.zh: 他们永远不会面对自己内心恐惧的部分，而在逃避它们的过程中，他们会把这些投射到你和我身上。

sentences.en: And this lack of self-awareness and self-discovery is a tragedy.
sentences.zh: 这种缺乏自我意识和自我发现的能力是一种悲剧。

sentences.en: You know, a tragedy that effective therapy, healthy spiritual practice, and loving families are seeking to remedy by expecting you to change and grow.
sentences.zh: 你知道，一种有效的心理治疗、健康的灵性实践和充满爱的家庭试图通过期望你改变和成长来补救的悲剧。

sentences.en: If you refuse to change, then yeah, you are the bad guy.
sentences.zh: 如果你拒绝改变，那么是的，你就是坏人。

sentences.en: If someone chooses that, let that be their choice.
sentences.zh: 如果有人选择了那样，就让他们做出自己的选择吧。

sentences.en: Let them be the antagoniSt.
sentences.zh: 让他们成为反派吧。

sentences.en: They could understand what you were saying if they wanted to understand themselves.
sentences.zh: 如果他们想了解自己，他们本可以理解你在说什么。

sentences.en: You can absolutely invite people into growth and change in a loving way.
sentences.zh: 你绝对可以用充满爱的方式邀请人们去成长和改变。

sentences.en: Whether someone accepts that invitation is up to them.
sentences.zh: 至于对方是否接受这个邀请，取决于他们自己。

sentences.en: Their reaction says nothing about you.
sentences.zh: 他们的反应与你无关。

sentences.en: If you exist authentically with love and honesty, anyone's reaction to that is up to them.
sentences.zh: 如果你带着爱和诚实真实地存在，任何人对此的反应都取决于他们自己。

sentences.en: If they dislike your honesty, it is the same thing as somebody yelling at a mountain or a rainstorm.
sentences.zh: 如果他们不喜欢你的诚实，这和有人对着大山或暴雨大喊大叫是一样的。

sentences.en: Maybe the weather, the terrain, or honesty and convenience of somebody, but that is not your fault.
sentences.zh: 也许是天气、地形，或者是某人的诚实和便利，但这都不是你的错。

sentences.en: That's just another part of reality that is being itself.
sentences.zh: 那只是现实中正在做它自己的另一部分。

sentences.en: So don't let yourself feel guilty if they are angry that you are honeSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他们因为你的诚实而愤怒，不要让自己感到内疚。

sentences.en: Any more than you would if somebody was yelling at the rain.
sentences.zh: 这和你看到有人对着雨大喊大叫时感到内疚是一样的。

sentences.en: You are only an advocate on behalf of reality, and you will not win every court case.
sentences.zh: 你只是现实的倡导者，你不可能赢得每一场官司。

sentences.en: Reality is just what it is, and we all choose how to cope with that.
sentences.zh: 现实就是它本来的样子，我们都选择如何去应对它。

sentences.en: Do your own journey, and let others choose if they want to do theirs.
sentences.zh: 走你自己的路，让别人选择他们是否想走他们的路。

sentences.en: Beneath all of our choices, that is really the only choice that we make.
sentences.zh: 在我们所有的选择之下，这确实是我们做出的唯一选择。

sentences.en: Face yourself, or die, never knowing what you are.
sentences.zh: 面对你自己，否则就在至死都不知道自己是谁的状态下死去。

sentences.en: Hey there, I hope you enjoyed the article.
sentences.zh: 嘿，希望你喜欢这篇文章。

sentences.en: Like I said before, you can always get on the www.gettherapybirmingham.com website, and subscribe to other podcasts, look at the blog, not all of the blog posts are turned into
sentences.zh: 就像我之前说的，你可以随时访问 www.gettherapybirmingham.com 网站，订阅其他播客，看看博客，并非所有的博客文章都被转化成了

sentences.en: articles, look at some of our free worksheets, some interesting ones on Jungian psychology, dissociative identity disorder, lots of stuff.
sentences.zh: 文章，看看我们的一些免费工作表，有一些关于荣格心理学、解离性身份障碍的有趣内容，还有很多东西。

sentences.en: I know that most of you are not in the Birmingham area, and this podcast has probably not helped me find any therapy patients, but that isn't the point.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们大多数人不在伯明翰地区，这个播客可能并没有帮我找到任何心理治疗的病人，但重点不在这里。

sentences.en: The point is that you can learn about this stuff, and we can find people who are on the same pathway somewhere, hopefully good, but at least honeSt.
sentences.zh: 重点是你可以了解这些东西，我们可以找到在同一条道路上的人，希望是好的，但至少是诚实的。

sentences.en: So, please check out the website, and I am almost embarrassed to admit this, but we just did a long show about honesty.
sentences.zh: 所以，请查看网站，我几乎不好意思承认这一点，但我们刚刚做了一个关于诚实的长节目。

sentences.en: So, I don't really want to monetize the podcast, or anything like that, but so many of the patients
sentences.zh: 所以，我并不真的想通过播客获利，或者类似的事情，但是很多来到我们诊所的病人

sentences.en: who come to our clinic have asked where we get our furniture, and then bought furniture
sentences.zh: 都问过我们从哪里买的家具，然后从

sentences.en: from Cardial, K-A-R-D-I-E-L, Cardial Furniture Company does a bunch of reproductions of modernist period furniture, and then some new modernist inspired stuff.
sentences.zh: Cardial（拼写为 K-A-R-D-I-E-L）购买了家具，Cardial 家具公司制作了很多现代主义时期家具的复刻品，还有一些新的受现代主义启发的东西。

sentences.en: So many patients asked where we got it, and then bought it, that Cardial made us a brand rep.
sentences.zh: 很多病人问我们在哪里买的，然后就买了，以至于 Cardial 让我们成为了品牌代表。

sentences.en: So, if you do want to buy Cardial furniture that does, you know, support taproot therapy,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你确实想购买 Cardial 家具来支持 Taproot Therapy，

sentences.en: you can use the promo code TAPROOT, all uppercase, I think, T-A-P-R-O-O-T, and you get 5% off.
sentences.zh: 你可以使用优惠码 TAPROOT，全大写，我想是 T-A-P-R-O-O-T，你可以获得 5% 的折扣。

sentences.en: So, if you want some modernist furniture, and you're planning on buying furniture that you saw at our place, use the promo code TAPROOT to get 5% off at cardial.com.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你想要一些现代主义家具，并且打算购买你在我们这里看到的家具，请使用优惠码 TAPROOT 在 cardial.com 上获得 5% 的折扣。

sentences.en: So, thank you, and if you have any questions, send me an email, I look forward to hearing from you, and signing off.
sentences.zh: 谢谢，如果你有任何问题，请给我发电子邮件，我很期待收到你的来信，节目到此结束。
